prompt: Write a single, self-contained prompt for a text-to-image model that has never heard of Chinese memes, so that it draws a giraffe version of the "大笑奶龙" (Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙) meme. Output only the prompt.
answer:
A chubby, round cartoon baby giraffe laughing hysterically, drawn in the style of a cheap, low-budget Chinese children's cartoon character turned internet reaction meme. The giraffe has a soft, squishy, bean-shaped body with almost no neck definition: a short, stubby, rounded neck that blends into a plump pear-shaped torso, tiny stubby arms raised up in glee, and short chunky legs. Its skin is bright buttery yellow with a few soft, rounded orange-brown giraffe spots, and it has a pale cream belly patch. Two tiny rounded ossicone horns sit on top of its head, along with small floppy ears and rosy pink blush circles on its cheeks.

The face is the focus. The mouth is absurdly huge and wide open in an over-the-top belly laugh, taking up half the face. It shows a deep red-pink mouth interior, a small pink tongue, and a few flat white teeth. The eyes are squeezed shut into thick upward-curved arcs, like "^ ^", from laughing so hard, with small tear drops flying from the corners. The head is tilted slightly back and the body leans with the laugh, conveying uncontrollable, slightly unhinged, smug hilarity.

Simple flat 2D cartoon look with clean thick dark outlines, minimal soft shading, and smooth glossy plastic-toy colors. The character is centered, full body, facing the viewer, on a plain flat white background. Make it look like a slightly compressed, low-resolution, oversaturated reaction image screenshot, with a meme-sticker feel. It should be funny, cute, and dumb at the same time. No text, no watermark, no other characters.
